name: Garry's Mod
description: Garry's Mod is a definitive physics sandbox powered by the Source engine. It offers ultimate freedom with no predefined goals — spawn props, build complex contraptions, and install thousands of community addons.
author: SGC-NOVUS Tech
startup_command: $( [ "$SERVER_ARCH" == "64" ] && printf %s './srcds_run_x64' || printf %s './srcds_run' ) -game garrysmod -console -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +ip 0.0.0.0 +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} +gamemode {{GAMEMODE}} -strictportbind -norestart +maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -tickrate {{TICKRATE}} $( [ "$LUA_REFRESH" == "1" ] || printf %s '-disableluarefresh' ) +hostname "{{SERVER_HOSTNAME}}" +sv_region {{SV_REGION}} +sv_location "{{SV_LOCATION}}" $( [ -n "$WORKSHOP_ID" ] && printf %s "+host_workshop_collection $WORKSHOP_ID" ) $( [ -n "$STEAM_API" ] && printf %s "-authkey $STEAM_API" ) $( [ -n "$STEAM_GSLT" ] && printf %s "+sv_setsteamaccount $STEAM_GSLT" ) $( [ -n "$SERVER_PASSWORD" ] && printf %s "+sv_password \"${SERVER_PASSWORD}\"" ) $( [ -n "$RCON_PASSWORD" ] && printf %s "+rcon_password \"${RCON_PASSWORD}\"" ) $( [ -n "$SV_TAGS" ] && printf %s "+sv_tags \"${SV_TAGS}\"" ) $( [ -n "$SV_LOADINGURL" ] && printf %s "+sv_loadingurl \"${SV_LOADINGURL}\"" ) $( [ -n "$SV_DOWNLOADURL" ] && printf %s "+sv_downloadurl \"${SV_DOWNLOADURL}\"" )
install_script:
#!/bin/bash
if [ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]; then
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
fi

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /home/container/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /home/container/steamcmd
mkdir -p /home/container/steamapps
cd /home/container/steamcmd

export HOME=/home/container

PLATFORM="linux"
if [ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]; then
    PLATFORM="windows"
fi

BETA_FLAG=""
if [ "${SERVER_ARCH}" == "64" ]; then
    BETA_FLAG="-beta x86-64"
fi

# Команда выбора платформы теперь идет строго ПЕРЕД логином
./steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType ${PLATFORM} +force_install_dir /home/container +login ${STEAM_USER:-anonymous} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID:-4020} ${BETA_FLAG} validate +quit

echo "4000" > /home/container/steam_appid.txt

mkdir -p /home/container/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so || true
mkdir -p /home/container/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so || true

mkdir -p /home/container/garrysmod/lua/bin
cd /home/container

LATEST_MYSQLOO_32=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/FredyH/MySQLOO/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name == "gmsv_mysqloo_linux.dll") | .browser_download_url')
if [ -n "$LATEST_MYSQLOO_32" ] && [ "$LATEST_MYSQLOO_32" != "null" ]; then
    curl -sL "$LATEST_MYSQLOO_32" -o /home/container/garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_mysqloo_linux.dll
fi

LATEST_MYSQLOO_64=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/FredyH/MySQLOO/releases/latest | jq -r '.assets[]? | select(.name == "gmsv_mysqloo_linux64.dll") | .browser_download_url')
if [ -n "$LATEST_MYSQLOO_64" ] && [ "$LATEST_MYSQLOO_64" != "null" ]; then
    curl -sL "$LATEST_MYSQLOO_64" -o /home/container/garrysmod/lua/bin/gmsv_mysqloo_linux64.dll
fi

mkdir -p /home/container/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server && cd /home/container/garrysmod/lua/autorun/server
echo '-- Docs: https://wiki.garrysmod.com/page/resource/AddWorkshop
resource.AddWorkshop( "" )' > workshop.lua

mkdir -p /home/container/garrysmod/cfg && cd /home/container/garrysmod/cfg
echo '// Please do not set RCon, Hostname, Password, Region, Location or URLs in here; use the startup parameters in panel.

sv_lan "0"
sv_max_queries_sec_global "30000"
sv_max_queries_window "45"
sv_max_queries_sec "5"

sbox_maxprops       100
sbox_maxragdolls    5
sbox_maxnpcs        10
sbox_maxballoons    10
sbox_maxeffects     10
sbox_maxdynamite    10
sbox_maxlamps       10
sbox_maxthrusters   10
sbox_maxwheels      10
sbox_maxhoverballs  10
sbox_maxvehicles    20
sbox_maxbuttons     10
sbox_maxsents       20
sbox_maxemitters    5
sbox_godmode        0
sbox_noclip         0

sv_minrate          75000
sv_maxrate          0
gmod_physiterations 2
net_splitpacket_maxrate 45000
decalfrequency      12

exec banned_ip.cfg
exec banned_user.cfg' > server.cfg

touch /home/container/garrysmod/cfg/banned_ip.cfg
touch /home/container/garrysmod/cfg/banned_user.cfg

chown -R container:container /home/container || true

client.name: Client Port
client.description: The primary port utilized by game clients to establish connections with your server.

primary.name: Primary Port
primary.description: The core server port responsible for general connections, queries, and RCON administration.

reserve.name: Reserve Port
reserve.description: A secondary fallback port automatically allocated if the primary port encounters binding conflicts.

sourcetv.name: SourceTV Port
sourcetv.description: The broadcast port dedicated to SourceTV spectator streaming and match recording.

variables.name: Server Architecture
variables.description: Select the binary architecture for the game engine. We strongly recommend the '64' (x86-64) branch for production servers to bypass the legacy 4GB RAM limit and drastically improve performance. Use '32' only if specific legacy addons require it.

variables.name: Server Hostname
variables.description: The public display name of your server in the Steam server browser. Note: The Source engine strictly truncates hostnames exceeding 63 characters. Keep it concise and impactful.

variables.name: Server Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated keywords to optimize your server's visibility in the in-game search engine (e.g., 'sandbox,rp,wiremod'). Spaces are strictly prohibited. Supports multiple languages.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: The authentication password required for players to join. Leave this field completely empty to operate a public server accessible to everyone.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: The cryptographic passphrase used for remote console (RCON) administration. For maximum security, leave this empty to permanently disable RCON if you manage permissions via in-game mods (like ULX/SAM/NovusAdmin).

variables.name: Steam Region
variables.description: Designates the geographic region for Steam master server routing. This affects how your server is categorized in the global browser (e.g., 0=US East, 1=US West, 2=South America, 3=Europe, 4=Asia, 5=Australia, 6=Middle East, 7=Africa, 255=World).

variables.name: Server Location
variables.description: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'DE', 'UA') used to display the correct national flag next to your server. Defaults to 'XX' for International.

variables.name: Loading Screen URL
variables.description: A custom HTTP/HTTPS web endpoint displayed while players connect. You can inject dynamic variables like '%s' (Player SteamID64) and '%m' (Current Map) to personalize the loading experience.

variables.name: FastDL URL
variables.description: The HTTP/HTTPS FastDL (Fast Download) endpoint. Drastically accelerates custom content (models, materials, sounds) delivery to clients by bypassing the slow native Source engine transfers.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The initial map loaded upon server startup (e.g., 'gm_flatgrass', 'rp_downtown_v4c_v2'). Ensure the respective map file is either mounted via the Steam Workshop or physically present in your 'garrysmod/maps/' directory.

variables.name: Steam Account Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Your Game Server Login Token (GSLT). Mandatory for anonymous players to connect and for proper Steam ranking. Generate this at: https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (Use AppID 4000).

variables.name: Workshop ID
variables.description: The numerical ID of your public Steam Workshop Collection. The server will automatically synchronize and mount all addons within this collection on boot. Extract the numbers from the end of your collection's URL.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: The foundational gamemode loaded by the engine. Must exactly match the gamemode's folder name in 'garrysmod/gamemodes/' (e.g., 'sandbox', 'darkrp', 'terrortown').

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The absolute maximum concurrent player slots. Be mindful of your hardware capabilities; Garry's Mod physics are heavily CPU-bound. The hard limit encoded by the engine is 128.

variables.name: Tickrate
variables.description: The simulation frequency (Ticks Per Second) of the server. 33 is the optimal gold standard for Garry's Mod. Higher values exponentially increase CPU load and network bandwidth overhead.

variables.name: Lua Refresh
variables.description: Toggles the Auto-Refresh subsystem for Lua scripts. Set to enabled (1) for active development. In production environments, set to disabled (0) to eliminate background disk I/O polling and conserve server resources.

variables.name: Steam AppID
variables.description: Steam AppID 4000 required for 64-bit Steam API initialization and Steam Web API integrations. Internal system variable.

variables.name: Source AppID (Server)
variables.description: AppID 4020 is used by SteamCMD to download necessary server depot files. Do not modify.
